results.title: Fijit Friends - Wikipedia
results.content:
Fijit Friends are a robot toy line directed toward girls created by Mattel, Radica Games and Girl Tech. They made their debut in July 2011 at the New York Toy Fair and are similar to the famous toy Furby. Their names are Logan, Serafina, Willa and Sage. As of 2016, it seems as if the line has been discontinued, as no new products have been released since 2013. The former web address redirects to Mattel's Customer service website.

Additional releases in the line are Fijit Newbies, Fijit Yippits, and Shimmies.

## Awards

[edit]

In 2012, the Fijit Friends Interactive Figures was awarded "Girl Toy of the Year" title at the 12th Annual Toy of the Year Awards, which is held at the American International Toy Fair in New York City.

results.title: Fijit Friends from Mattel
results.content:
Fijit Friends are funny, interactive robots that dance and talk. There are four characters in different colors: Willa, Sage, Serafina, and Logan. In Home Mode, each Fijit performs random routines while waiting for commands. The Fijit recognizes more than 30 key words that are spoken to it and responds with more than 150 phrases. When girls talk to it, the Fijit will offer an appropriate response. If the Fijit asks, "What are you up to?", girls can say, "School" or "Nothing" and the Fijit will then continue the conversation. The Fijit also dances (to its own music or to music played by girls) and tells jokes. Each Fijit comes with removable ears and a key words reference card. [...] # Fijit Friends from Mattel
